threads.title: How to improve active listening skills?
threads.author: Sarah Johnson

messages.author: Sarah Johnson
messages.content: I've been practicing active listening but still struggle with staying focused. Any tips?

messages.author: Instructor Sadat
messages.content: Great question! Try the RASA technique: Receive (pay attention), Appreciate (make encouraging sounds), Summarize (repeat back what you heard), and Ask questions. Start with one conversation a day and build from there.

messages.author: Michael Chen
messages.content: What are the best ways to budget for textbooks and rent on a student income?

messages.author: Instructor Sadat
messages.content: Start with fixed costs, set a savings target, and then allocate the remainder. Apps can help track spending and cut non-essentials.

messages.author: Emma Davis
messages.content: I keep delaying assignments until the last minute. How do you build momentum?

messages.author: Instructor Sadat
messages.content: Try breaking tasks into 20-minute blocks and celebrate small wins. Consistency beats intensity.
